skill.name: context-manager

skill.summary: Design context architectures that manage token budgets, memory, retrieval quality, and workflow state.

content.value_statement: AI applications lose relevance when context, memory, and retrieval systems are poorly designed. This skill guides context architecture, RAG, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent state management.
actual_capabilities: Designs dynamic context assembly, pruning, relevance filtering, and token budget strategies.
Recommends vector database, embedding, semantic search, and hybrid retrieval approaches.
Structures RAG pipelines with chunking, query understanding, ranking, and freshness controls.
Plans persistent, episodic, semantic, and working memory architectures.
Defines multi-agent context routing, handoffs, state management, and conflict resolution.
Proposes quality, latency, cost, relevance, and staleness metrics for context systems.
limitations: Provides architecture guidance but does not deploy databases, models, APIs, or monitoring systems.
Requires environment-specific requirements, permissions, testing, and expert review before implementation.
Does not independently access enterprise data sources or validate live retrieval performance.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in the reviewed package.

use_cases.title: Plan a Support Context Architecture
use_cases.description: Design retrieval, memory, and agent handoffs for consistent responses across long-running customer cases.

use_cases.title: Improve Enterprise Document Retrieval
use_cases.description: Select chunking, embedding, hybrid search, ranking, and freshness strategies for a large internal document collection.

use_cases.title: Control Multi-Agent Workflow State
use_cases.description: Define context ownership, routing, handoff, and recovery rules for a coordinated AI workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Basic Context Needs
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this AI workflow: [workflow]. Identify required context, missing inputs, token constraints, and a simple assembly strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Retrieval Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a RAG pipeline for [corpus]. Recommend chunking, embeddings, retrieval, ranking, freshness checks, and evaluation metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Long-Term Memory
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a memory strategy for [application]. Separate working, episodic, semantic, and persistent memory with retention and retrieval rules.

prompt_templates.title: Architect Multi-Agent Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Architect context management for [agents and workflow]. Define ownership, handoffs, isolation, token budgets, failure recovery, governance, and measurable service targets.

output_examples.input: Design context management for a customer support assistant with long-running cases.
output_examples.output: Use a compact working summary, retrieve case evidence on demand, store approved durable facts, and log every agent handoff.

output_examples.input: Improve retrieval quality for a large technical document collection.
output_examples.output: Test structure-aware chunks, combine semantic and keyword retrieval, rerank candidates, filter stale versions, and measure grounded answer quality.

output_examples.input: Reduce token use across a multi-agent workflow.
output_examples.output: Assign context ownership, pass task-specific summaries, retrieve details only when needed, and track token cost per successful workflow.

best_practices: Define measurable relevance, latency, cost, freshness, and privacy requirements before selecting components.
Separate durable facts, conversation history, retrieved evidence, and temporary working context.
Evaluate retrieval and final responses with representative tasks, failure cases, and stale data.
anti_patterns: Do not place every available document into each prompt.
Do not choose an embedding model or vector database without measured requirements.
Do not store sensitive conversation history without retention, access, and deletion controls.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy infrastructure?
faq.answer: No. It provides design guidance and validation steps but does not deploy databases, models, APIs, or monitoring systems.

faq.question: Which vector databases does it cover?
faq.answer: It discusses Pinecone, Weaviate, and Qdrant, with selection based on scale, latency, governance, and operational requirements.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing RAG system?
faq.answer: Yes. It can assess chunking, retrieval, ranking, freshness, quality metrics, latency, and cost.

faq.question: Does it address privacy and governance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers isolation, retention, audit trails, and privacy-aware architecture, but regulated deployments still require qualified review.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide users, workflows, data sources, scale, latency, token limits, privacy constraints, current architecture, and success metrics.

faq.question: Are implementation files included?
faq.answer: No. The skill references an implementation playbook, but that file is not included in the reviewed package.
